title: Weekend Delivery Surcharge for Fleet Units
content:
**Commercial Vehicle Center delivery schedule, Vehicle Purchase Agreements**

A fleet delivery made on a weekend carries a weekend delivery surcharge. The surcharge applies to a unit delivered under a **Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement**, and the day that counts is the delivery date recorded on the deal.

| Delivery date falls on | Weekend delivery surcharge |
|---|---|
| Saturday | USD 45.00 |
| Sunday | USD 85.00 |
| Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday or Friday | none |

## Clause

A unit whose delivery date is a Saturday carries a surcharge of 45.00. A unit whose delivery date is a Sunday carries a surcharge of 85.00. A unit delivered Monday through Friday carries no weekend delivery surcharge.

## Points of judgement

- **The date tested is the delivery date on the deal.** It is not the contract date and not the date the support desk handles the deal.
- **The surcharge is a flat amount per unit.** It does not change with the distance driven.
- **Hypothetical case.** Two fleet units on one hypothetical order go out on consecutive days, one on a Friday and one on the Saturday that follows. The Friday unit carries no surcharge, and the Saturday unit carries 45.00.
